consigne_scene: Evocation of a modest 2nd-century AD villa rustica in northern Gaul, a rural farming estate, nothing like a palace or a town, seen from a low hill in warm late afternoon light: a long single-storey stone main house with red clay tile roofs and a colonnaded gallery facing a small walled courtyard, a few barns, stables and farm sheds around a large walled farmyard with a big rectangular water basin, a small stream lined with willows, meadows, a vegetable garden, dark conifer forest on the gentle hills behind, a thin wisp of smoke from one roof, tiny distant figures only, too small to show any face
